updates.title: About and updates
updates.confirm: Lumina stops your services, installs the update and restarts. The services that are running now start again afterwards.
updates.safety: Updates are signed and checked before they are installed. They replace only the program; your projects, databases, certificates and settings stay where they are.

configWarnings.php_children_raised: PHP_FCGI_CHILDREN={{from}} is too low; Lumina uses {{to}}.
configWarnings.port_zero_reset: A port was set to 0; using {{default}}.
configWarnings.php_ports_same: The PHP fallback port is the same as the main port ({{port}}).
configWarnings.tld_reset: The domain suffix "{{value}}" is invalid; using .test.
configWarnings.editor_reset: No editor command was set; using the default editor.
configWarnings.config_restored: config.toml was damaged and has been restored from the backup. The damaged copy is {{file}}.
configWarnings.config_reset: config.toml was damaged and no backup was usable, so the defaults are used. The damaged copy is {{file}}.
configWarnings.tld_https_only: .{{tld}} is a real domain suffix that browsers only open over HTTPS, so these sites will not load until HTTPS is set up. Use .test instead.

web.title: Web server
web.notInstalled: {{server}} is not installed yet. Put it in {{path}}.
web.unchanged: Nothing changed; no reload was needed.

portConflict.body: {{owner}} is already using port {{port}}, so the web server cannot start. Use port {{alternative}} instead? Your sites will then be at http://localhost:{{alternative}}.
portConflict.bodyService: {{owner}} is already using port {{port}}, so {{service}} cannot start. Use port {{alternative}} instead?

db.login: Log in as root with no password, at 127.0.0.1. Only this computer can connect.

auto.description: Every folder in {{folder}} gets its own address: a folder named blog opens at http://blog.{{tld}}.
auto.localWarning: On macOS, .local is used for devices on the network (Bonjour), which can make these sites slow to open. .test is safer.

ssl.title: HTTPS
ssl.description: Every site and localhost also answer at https://, with certificates from a certificate authority that exists only on this computer.
ssl.noCa: The certificate authority is created the next time the web server starts.
ssl.trusted: Trusted by this computer: browsers show a padlock for every site.
ssl.untrusted: Not trusted yet, so browsers warn about these sites. Trust it once and every site gets a padlock.
ssl.wrongTld: This certificate authority cannot sign for .{{tld}}. Regenerate it to cover the new domain suffix.
ssl.declined: The confirmation was declined, so nothing changed.
ssl.forceHttps: Force HTTPS: redirect http:// to https:// on every site
ssl.firefox: Once the certificate authority is trusted, Firefox is set to use this computer's certificates too.

packages.intro: Download and switch versions of every tool. Each download is checked against its published SHA-256 before it is unpacked.
packages.autoNewest: the newest installed version is used
packages.autoDbUi: the newest version that runs on the active PHP is used
packages.dbUiServed: phpMyAdmin {{version}} is served at /phpmyadmin/ for PHP {{php}}.
packages.dbUiNone: None of the installed versions runs on PHP {{php}}. Install a compatible one below.
packages.dbUiInstall: Install phpMyAdmin to manage your databases at http://localhost/phpmyadmin/.
packages.noneForPlatform: No downloads for this operating system yet.
packages.useNewest: Always use the newest installed version
packages.useAutoDbUi: Pick automatically for the active PHP
packages.cancelled: Cancelled. Install again to resume the download.

homebrew.intro: Its project publishes no download for this system. Install it with Homebrew, the standard way on macOS and Linux, by running this in Terminal:
homebrew.notFound: Its project publishes no download for this system. Install Homebrew first (see brew.sh), then run this in Terminal:
homebrew.after: Lumina finds Homebrew versions on its own and runs them with its own settings. For another version, use the formula with the version, for example brew install php@8.3.

profiles.intro: Save whole stacks and switch between them in one click. Only the services that differ are restarted; if anything fails, the previous stack is restored.
profiles.switching: Switching… only the services that differ are restarted.
profiles.empty: No profiles yet. Save the current stack below, or create one.
profiles.name: Name

path.intro: Put Lumina's php, composer, node, npm, python and mysql on your terminal's PATH. Lumina adds one folder once; switching versions here changes what those commands run, without touching PATH again.
path.notAdded: Lumina is not on your PATH
path.restartHint: Open a new terminal (and restart VS Code) to see the change; terminals that are already open keep their old PATH.
path.shadowed: A new terminal finds `{{command}}` at {{found}} first, before Lumina's. Remove that folder from the system PATH (or move it after Lumina's) to use Lumina's.
path.noCommands: Nothing to put on PATH yet. Install PHP, Composer or Node.js in Quick Add.
path.cmdShims: Development build without lumina-shim: commands use .cmd launchers (build it with cargo build -p lumina-shim).
path.systemHint: Windows searches the machine-wide PATH before yours, so a PHP, Composer or Node.js installed for all users wins. Put Lumina first there too (one administrator prompt).
path.addSystem: Put Lumina first for all users
path.addedSystem: Also first on the machine-wide PATH. "Remove from PATH" takes it off both (one administrator prompt).
